entry.name_in_paper: quantification of antigen-specific CD4 T cells
entry.readouts: frequency of peanut-stimulated CD40L+ CD69+ CD4 T cells; fold change over unstimulated condition

evidence.quote: For quantification of antigen-specific CD4 T cells following peanut stimulation, CD40L + CD69 + cells were identified within the CD4 T-cell population by manual gating 14 .
